technique_name: Describe a traditional wedding ceremony you attended
description: I recently attended a traditional wedding ceremony of a friend. The guests were welcomed with a ceremonial procession and the bride and groom were dressed in traditional attires. The ceremony was full of vibrant colors and lively music. Several rituals and traditions were performed such as exchanging of garlands, tying of the thaal, the vidaai, and blessings and wishes from elders.
